title: CHGR shared enums
description: The closed enums frozen for the CHGR schema family (Phase 143E, CHGR-001 v1.0 Sec.12, Sec.13.1). Unknown-value behavior is reject (fail closed) for every enum here; no alias, case-fold, or substring match is ever permitted. Independently defined from src/pcae/schema_resources/cltr_cutover/shared/enums.schema.json per CHGR-001 Sec.16/Sec.19.1's no-composition-across-families rule.

assurance_level.description: CHGR-001 Sec.12's six-level assurance model. L0 (explicit typed confirmation) and L1 (authenticated local-user confirmation) are the only levels this increment's HumanConfirmationEvidence shape actually supports; L2-L5 values are accepted structurally (open extension point per CHGR-REQ-099) but no confirmer_identity_evidence shape supporting them is implemented this increment -- a record declaring L2-L5 without matching evidence fails ASSURANCE_OVERCLAIM verification (governance/verification.py), never a schema-level rejection.

lifecycle_state.description: The complete eight-state model CHGR-001 Sec.13.1/CHGR-REQ-106 freezes, including 'invalidated' -- CHGR-001 Sec.13.4 explicitly resolves a seven-vs-eight-state ambiguity in its own governing prompt by freezing all eight, reasoning that 'invalidated' (a structural-integrity finding) is categorically distinct from 'revoked' (a human's substantive change of mind) and omitting it would leave no way to represent a structurally untrustworthy record without misrepresenting it as still-valid or as revoked. No transition command exists this increment; this enum exists so lifecycle state can be structurally represented (CHGR-REQ-106/107) without enabling any lifecycle operation.

record_family.description: Closed nomenclature for the six CHGR artifact types implemented this increment (Phase 143E). Naming a family here does not create, instantiate, or authorize its schema file beyond what this phase actually implements. DecisionSession (ephemeral, never published), GovernanceRecordIndexEntry (requires a runtime registry), and LegacyRecordImportEvidence (import is out of scope) are deliberately excluded -- none has anything to be built for without a live publication/storage/import capability, none of which exists this increment.
